gripOrHq.title: Project Babylon
gripOrHq.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

gripOrHq.title: Security Purge
gripOrHq.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

gripOrHq.title: Project Venice
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Retreat
gripOrHq.rulesText: You lose the following ability as soon as you rez or install any card. A: Gain [2].

gripOrHq.title: Project Zurich
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Systematic Layoffs
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Cortical Scrub
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

discardCards.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

rig.title: Schematics Search Engine
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.

rig.title: MS-todon
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. The first time during each run that you break a sentry subroutine with MS-todon, lose all bits from all stealth cards, if you can, and the Corp gives you a tag.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

ice.title: Dog Pile
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Cortical Scrub
root.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Cortical Scrub
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.
